necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or tachy-brady syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of correlating symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
